chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Ahmad ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aasim, from his father, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who sleeps upon antimony (kohl) that is not secured (with musk or similar) will be safe from the black water (blackness in the eyes) forever, as long as he sleeps upon it.

key_terms.إِثْمِد: Antimony or kohl, a substance used for eye makeup and medicinal purposes.
key_terms.الْمَاءِ الْأَسْوَد: The black water, a traditional term for a condition causing blackness or cloudiness in the eye.
key_terms.مُمَسَّك: Secured or fixed, often implying mixed with a binding agent like musk or wax to prevent it from falling out.

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of sleeping with kohl in the eyes according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from al-Kafi highlights the dual physical and spiritual benefits of ithmid (antimony sulfide), linking its prophetic use to both ocular health and protection from 'black water,' a condition often interpreted as cataracts or spiritual dimness. The emphasis on securing the kohl reflects the scholarly focus on practical adherence to Sunnah for maintaining both bodily purity and spiritual clarity.
